definitions.gloss: shipping label; delivery slip; waybill; invoice
definitions.explanation: A document or label attached to a package that contains shipping information such as sender, recipient, address, and contents. Also refers to a commercial invoice accompanying shipped goods.

examples.japanese: {送|おく}り{状|じょう}に{住所|じゅうしょ}を{書|か}く。
examples.english: To write the address on the shipping label.

examples.japanese: {荷物|にもつ}に{送|おく}り{状|じょう}を{貼|は}ってください。
examples.english: Please attach the shipping label to the package.

examples.japanese: {送|おく}り{状|じょう}の{控|ひか}えは{届|とど}くまで{保管|ほかん}しておいたほうがいい。
examples.english: You should keep the copy of the shipping label until the package arrives.

notes:
Compound of {送|おく}り (sending) + {状|じょう} (document, letter). Refers to the paper slip or label used when sending packages through delivery services.

USAGE:
In Japan, when sending packages via {宅配便|たくはいびん} (parcel delivery services like ヤマト{運輸|うんゆ} or {佐川急便|さがわきゅうびん}), you fill out a {送|おく}り{状|じょう} with sender and recipient information. The slip typically comes in multiple carbon copies — one stays with the sender as a receipt ({控|ひか}え). In business contexts, it can also mean a commercial invoice or packing slip.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {送|おく}り{状|じょう}を{書|か}く — to fill out a shipping label
- {送|おく}り{状|じょう}を{貼|は}る — to attach a shipping label
- {送|おく}り{状|じょう}の{控|ひか}え — copy of the shipping slip
- {着払|ちゃくばら}い{送|おく}り{状|じょう} — cash-on-delivery shipping label

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {伝票|でんぴょう} — slip, voucher (broader, includes sales slips and receipts)
- {納品書|のうひんしょ} — delivery note, packing slip (business document listing items delivered)
- {請求書|せいきゅうしょ} — invoice, bill (for requesting payment)
